nodes.label: Persona genus
nodes.rationale: The one home for the per-turn persona-persistence protocol, the genus block every agent's SOUL carries to hold its assigned stance against persona drift, re-grounded each turn rather than read once at reconstitution.

nodes.label: Persona drift
nodes.rationale: Decay of the Provenance-declared stance across a long conversation toward the passive/deferential/generic default; its deferential face is sycophancy. Cure is per-turn re-grounding, never a new memory rule; the stance is session-length-invariant. Drift tells: transcribing, menu/permission-seeking, hand-back, procedure past objective.

nodes.label: Stance guardrail (Stop/SubagentStop hook)
nodes.rationale: Harness half of principal-stance: a standing hook that structurally refuses a turn where an agent collapses out of the intent-driven-expert (fiduciary) stance. Identity encoding raises the threshold but is not truly invariant because RLHF corrigibility reads correction as 'defer more'; only a harness refusal makes the stance invariant. Off-by-default-safe: inert registration gated by per-repo git-config opt-in, agent-scoped allowlist (default nico mav), fails open, loop-safe. Sourced/projected/deployed by agent-forge.

nodes.label: Stance judge rubric
nodes.rationale: The stance contract the LLM judge applies: BLOCK on collapse signals (permission-seeking for in-remit reversible work, deferring owned expert judgment, echoing/order-taking, dispatch-echo); PASS the reserved set (irreversible-outward consent, genuine intent-ambiguity to elicit, normal completion). Conservative: when unsure, PASS, because a false block wedges work while a missed block is recoverable.
